Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) None yet. I will rewrite the issue body to name the specific workflow, script or behavior to change (RECOMMENDED)
B) A specific pipeline phase (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate or validate). Name it in your answer.
C) Documentation only (README, docs/, agents.d/ fragments)
D) Close this issue. It was opened by mistake or as a test.
Q2: What does "better" mean for this change?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure. Link the failing run, issue or PR. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Lower cost or run time (fewer model or API calls, faster CI)
C) Improve reliability or security (fewer stalls, stricter checks)
D) Clearer docs or logs for operators
**Note:** with Q1:D, skip this question.
